title: Ensure resetAllData handles cabin images: delete and re-upload to Supabase storage
description:

title: Fix upstream image timeout error in dataReset feature
description:
When using the dataReset feature, the following error occurs:

```
⨯ upstream image response timed out for https://xymetprhvhaodfebesxu.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/cabin-images/cabin-002.jpg
Error: "url" parameter is valid but upstream response timed out
  statusCode: 504

⨯ Error: aborted
  code: 'ECONNRESET',
  digest: '28012489'
```

This appears to be a timeout issue when Next.js attempts to fetch/optimize images from Supabase storage during or after the reset process. Possible causes:
- Image optimization timeout during data reset
- Race condition where images are being accessed before upload completes
- Next.js image cache issues with Supabase URLs
- Network timeout settings too short for image uploads

Potential fixes to investigate:
- Add retry logic for image uploads
- Increase timeout settings
- Clear Next.js image cache after reset
- Ensure images are fully uploaded before referencing them
- Add error handling/fallbacks for image loading failures

Files to investigate:
- src/features/dataReset/actions.ts
- src/features/dataReset/hooks/
- src/services/supabase/storage/images.ts
close_reason: Fixed by using timestamped filenames during image upload, ensuring unique URLs that bypass Next.js image optimization cache

title: Fix Base UI nativeButton warning in cabins page dropdown menu
description:
Console error appears on the cabins page related to Base UI button component:

```
Base UI: A component that acts as a button was not rendered as a native <button>, 
which does not match the default. Ensure that the element passed to the `render` 
prop of the component is a real <button>, or set the `nativeButton` prop on the 
component to `false`.
```

**Stack trace points to:**
- `DropdownMenuItem` component
- `CabinsTableColumnActionsRowItem` in the cabins table
- Occurs during passive mount effects in React

**Root cause:**
A Base UI component (likely in the dropdown menu) is rendering a button-like element that isn't a native `<button>` tag. This commonly happens when:
- Using `render` prop to customize the element
- Wrapping button components in other elements
- Using `asChild` patterns incorrectly

**Fix options:**
1. Ensure the dropdown menu item renders as a native `<button>`
2. Set `nativeButton={false}` on the affected component if non-button rendering is intentional

**Files to investigate:**
- src/components/ui/dropdown-menu.tsx (DropdownMenuItem component)
- src/features/cabins/cabinsTable/ (CabinsTableColumnActionsRowItem)

Next.js version: 16.1.1 (Turbopack)
close_reason: Added nativeButton={false} to DropdownMenuItem using Link render prop, since Link renders as <a> not <button>
